tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows direction-dependent step responses, but its sparse, coupled variations do not identify the response shape or its long-horizon behavior. A fine trajectory batch is the available discriminating measurement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The opposing step responses are not explained by the supplied mean-reversion form alone.
The unchanged-input observation retains the present state, so the supplied stress-only form is insufficient as a complete readout.
